headline: President Obama ordered that the US-held property of people found to threaten peace, security, or stability in Burma be frozen.
what_it_does: This executive order allows the US government to block, or freeze, property and assets under US control that belong to people found to threaten the peace, security, or stability of Burma (also called Myanmar). Blocked property generally cannot be transferred, sold, or used. No summary was provided, so details such as who decides which people are named are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups found to threaten peace, security, or stability in Burma
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under US control can be frozen.
They would generally be barred from dealing in property belonging to people named under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 11, 2012; the exact effective date is not given in the source material.
